components.name: Agent Runtime
components.description: Managed execution environment for running AI agents on GPU-powered infrastructure. Handles orchestration, scaling, and lifecycle management for deployed agents.

components.name: Inference
components.description: Serverless access to foundation models (e.g. Llama, Mistral, GPT) via OpenAI-compatible API.

components.name: ADK
components.description: (Agent Development Kit) Open-source toolkit for building, testing, and deploying AI agents locally or in the cloud via CLI and SDK integrations.

components.name: Knowledge Bases
components.description: RAG-powered document stores that give agents access to your data. Supports multiple data sources for accurate, context-aware responses.

components.name: Guardrails
components.description: Content safety layer that filters agent inputs and outputs. Enforces topic restrictions and behavioral boundaries to keep agents on-task and compliant.

components.name: Model Services
components.description: Hosts and serves foundation and embedding models for serverless and dedicated inference workloads across the Gradient AI Platform.

incidents.name: Continuation of Global Networking Maintenance
incidents.message:
Impact: maintenance;
Our Engineering team has completed all of the work necessary for this maintenance. All regions are now complete and upgraded Hypervisors no longer have the bottlenecks that were occurring previously.

Thank you for your patience throughout this longer than expected maintenance period. Should you have any questions or concerns, please open up a Support ticket from within your account.

Affected Components: Services - Networking Regions - Global 

Status: completed
2020-10-30 16:29 UTC
-

The maintenance effort continues to progress. At this time, we have completed work in the following regions:
FRA1, SFO3, BLR1, NYC1, TOR1

In total, we are approximately 85% complete in this maintenance effort, and we expect to complete this maintenance Thursday, October 29, 2020. 

As a reminder, if you have any questions or concerns about this maintenance, please open a Support ticket from within your account.

Affected Components: Services - Networking Regions - Global 

Status: in_progress
2020-10-28 19:17 UTC
-

The maintenance effort continues to progress. At this time, we have completed work in the following regions: 
FRA1 and SFO3

We are approximately 70%-75% complete in these regions: 
NYC1, TOR1, and BLR1

We are approximately 45% complete in all other regions across our fleet. 

In total, we are approximately 65% complete in this maintenance effort. 

We will continue to provide updates here as incrementally complete this effort.

As a reminder, if you have any questions or concerns about this maintenance, please open a Support ticket from within your account.

Affected Components: Services - Networking Regions - Global 

Status: in_progress
2020-10-22 15:23 UTC
-

The maintenance effort continues to progress. At this time, we are approximately 65% complete across all regions. Our Engineering team has seen significant unexpected issues with this maintenance rollout, and at this time we will be proceeding more slowly and with a targeted approach in our FRA1 region. This will allow our team to continue the rollout, but help ensure that Droplets are not losing networking capabilities as a result of the rollout.

We will continue to provide updates here as incrementally complete this effort.

As a reminder, if you have any questions or concerns about this maintenance, please open a Support ticket from within your account.

Affected Components: Services - Networking Regions - Global 

Status: in_progress
2020-10-12 17:45 UTC
-

Our Engineering team will be continuing the previous maintenance here: https://status.digitalocean.com/incidents/ndnk5k7t2mxr

This is in order to reduce bottlenecks that limit network throughput and stability under certain user workloads on DigitalOcean Hypervisors.

We expect this effort to be ongoing from today, October 5, 2020, to October 15, 2020, and will be rolling out incrementally across our fleet. As of today, we are about 25% complete across our fleet.

Expected Impact:

There should be minimal downtime for Droplets on each affected hypervisor during the rollout. The expectation is that most users will not observe any impact, though some users with a sustained high-packets-per-second or high-throughput workload will see a small number of dropped packets.

Should users have questions about specific Droplets and this maintenance, we ask that they open a Support ticket within their account for assistance. Thank you for your patience throughout this process.

Affected Components: Services - Networking Regions - Global 

Status: scheduled
2020-10-06 13:07 UTC
-

incidents.message:
Impact: minor;

Status: resolved
2020-09-30 04:16 UTC
-

From 09:02 UTC to 9:50 UTC, and then from 15:04 UTC to 16:30 UTC, our Engineering team observed an issue with intermittent failures and increased latency for networking in our AMS2 region. Users may have experienced packet loss/latency, connections issues, and/or errors or timeouts returned within Droplets and Droplet-based services like Managed Kubernetes with regards to DNS resolution and queries. Our team was able to take quick action to resolve the issue that was causing those symptoms. 

At this time, our Engineering team is monitoring this incident, and there may be residual issues with a subset of Droplets in our AMS2 region. We are actively monitoring and taking action as necessary and we will post an update as soon as we have further information. 

Thank you for your patience thus far.
